prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A vibrant, whimsical game title screen featuring an adorable anthropomorphic fox standing upright on a lush, sunlit golf course. The fox has large, expressive blue eyes, a fluffy orange and white coat, and oversized ears, exuding a playful and inviting demeanor. It wears a neatly buttoned green polo shirt, adding a sporty touch, and holds a golf club poised next to a golf ball on the manicured grass. The background is softly blurred, with hints of wildflowers and distant trees bathed in warm, golden sunlight, creating a dreamy, welcoming atmosphere. The color palette is rich and saturated, dominated by fresh greens, warm oranges, and soft blues, with gentle, natural lighting that enhances the fox’s fur texture and the scene’s cheerful mood. The composition is centered, with the fox as the focal point, and large, bold, cartoon-style title text “Super Fox Golf Challenge” at the top. Below, three glossy, rounded buttons—“Start Single,” “Options,” and “Quit Game”—are stacked, inviting interaction. The overall style is polished, family-friendly, and reminiscent of high-quality animated films or modern 3D platformer games, with a shallow depth of field and a slight upward camera angle to emphasize the fox’s charm and the inviting environment.
